summary_en: Decree promulgating the Martyrologium Romanum, editio typica altera (2004), followed by the full list of variations from the 2001 edition: emended praenotanda, 114 new elogia for 117 Saints and Blesseds (51 saints of ancient cult, 66 Blesseds beatified 7 Oct 2001 – 25 Apr 2004, plus the elogium of Our Lady of Guadalupe recently inserted in the General Calendar), 19 elogia set among the praetermissa, and 27 elogia moved to another day. The individual elogia are not itemised here.
excerpt:
Prot. N. 1140/04/L
DECRETUM
[…] Proinde Congregatio de Cultu Divino et Disciplina Sacramentorum editionem hanc alteram Martyrologii Romani vigore facultatum specialium a Summo Pontifice IOANNE PAULO PP. II ipsi tributarum nunc promulgat et « typicam » esse declarat. […] die 29 mensis iunii anni 2004, in sollemnitate Ss. Petri et Pauli, Apostolorum.
